messages:
Alex G: @Oncall Bot just fired a pager for P1 - embeddings.high-latency in prod (~09:17 UTC). p95 > 3s across multiple pods. Incident details: alert 87321.
Oncall Bot: Incident 87321 created and routed to primary: Samir K. Pager links: https://pager.redwood/87321 
Samir K: I'm taking this. Quick check: are we seeing CPU or queuing? I'm checking worker metrics and queue depth.
Maria L: I see elevated queue depth on embeddings-worker-2 and 3. Possible GC spike. Will watch logs.
Jin H: Customer "Enterprise Analytics" reported 504s on ingest pipeline — ticket #EA-4493. Notified CS.
Samir K: Starting mitigations: scaling embeddings workers up and rolling fallback to smaller model for latency-sensitive customers. Executing: `rictl route set --service embeddings --target emb-v1-small --weight 100 --reason "mitigate latency"`
Alex G: If we need human coverage over weekend: I'm out Sun 00:00-48h UTC (travel). Can someone pick primary for Sat night?
Priya S: I can cover Sat-Sun overlap (Fri 22:00 - Mon 02:00 UTC) as shadow/secondary. Happy to escalate if things go sideways.
Samir K: I can be primary Sat night 00:00-08:00 UTC but need a secondary to cover APAC morning 03:00-07:00 UTC. Jin H: I can be secondary for that window.
Maria L: I'll update runbook notes and leave exact commands. Current status: fallback applied, restarted pool for embeddings, scaled workers to 4 replicas. Monitoring p95 and error-rate.
Maria L: Runbook quick commands (for whoever picks up):
```
# route fallback to smaller model
rictl route set --service embeddings --target emb-v1-small --weight 100 --reason "mitigate latency"
# restart pool
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/embeddings-pool
# scale workers
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/embeddings-worker --replicas=4
# check p95
rictl metrics query --metric embeddings.latency.p95 --window 5m
```
Samir K: Note: if error-rate > 2% after fallback, rollback and investigate model input size. See playbook section "Fallback -> Monitor errors" lines 12-22.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: add a handoff note with `incident add-note 87321 "handed to <name> at <time>"` and update the incident timeline.
Priya S: Acknowledged — I'll shadow from 22:00 UTC and run smoke checks every 10m: `curl -sS https://prod.embed/health` and post failures here.
Jin H: I'll take EA ticket ownership until we confirm customer ingest is green. Will notify CS when we move from P1 to P2.
Alex G: Thanks team. Samir — please add short handoff summary before you log off. Also confirm who will be primary at 02:00 UTC.
Samir K: Handing off timeline: primary Sat night -> Samir K (00:00-08:00 UTC), secondary -> Jin H (03:00-07:00 UTC), shadow -> Priya S (22:00-02:00 UTC). Applied mitigations: fallback to emb-v1-small, restarted pool, scaled workers. Monitoring thresholds set: p95 < 1s for fallback, errors < 1.5%.
Maria L: Customer impact note: EA ingest saw 30% request failures during spike; after fallback errors down to 0.8% and latency improved. CS notified.
Oncall Bot: Incident 87321 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Suggested follow-ups: post-incident RCA, consider autoscaler tuning for embeddings-worker.
Priya S: I'll keep shadowing through 02:00 and will escalate if anything regresses. Posting a quick checklist I'll follow on handoff: 1) verify `prod/embed/health` every 10m 2) monitor `embeddings.latency.p95` 3) check `embeddings.traffic.failed` 4) update incident with notes.
Alex G: Final note — I've added my weekend OOO in the schedule. Priya / Samir / Jin please confirm the PD schedule update once you add yourselves. :thumbsup:
Samir K: Confirmed. Added notes to incident 87321 and to the runbook. Leaving the thread open for any late questions. :white_check_mark:
